brief:
Rapper Macklemore wrapped up his "Free Palestine" tour with a final sold-out performance in London, according to Al Jazeera English. The tour, which centered on solidarity with Palestinians, concluded with the musician delivering a message of support to the audience.

The sold-out show marked the end of a tour dedicated to raising awareness about the Palestinian cause through Macklemore's platform as a recording artist.
dek: Macklemore’s ‘Free Palestine’ tour ended with a sold-out show in London.
title: Macklemore concludes Free Palestine tour in sold-out London show
